title: You Might Already Be Too Late
script_text:
I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.
You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.
You heard my words. You never heard my silence.
You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.
By the time you finally understand me, it might already be too late.

title: I'm Keeping You Forever
script_text:
I love the way you love.
I love your gentle soul.
I love the way you make the hardest days feel absolutely effortless.
Even when we are exhausted.
Even when we are overwhelmed.
Even when we are just sitting in complete silence.
I look at you, and I know.
I found exactly what my heart was looking for.
I'm keeping you forever.

title: What Is Love
script_text:
What is love?
It's giving someone the complete power to change your life.
It can bring hope, build you up, or sometimes destroy you completely.
The one who loves you can bring a smile to your face with the smallest things,
or break you entirely. Is this truly what love means?

title: I Hope You Know
script_text:
I hope you know you make me happy.
I know it sounds simple, but I mean it from the heart.
A regular day becomes beautiful when I spend it with you.
You make me believe in love again.
We fight, we make up, we talk, we comfort each other, and in all these little things, I feel how much love there is.

title: Choose Your Peace
script_text:
At some point, you will have to disappoint others to live a life that's honest to you.
People-pleasing will drain you, not save you.
You have every right to set boundaries and choose your peace.
You can disappoint people and still be a good person.

title: I'm Not Born To Impress Others
script_text:
I don't care what others think about me.
I'm not born to impress others.
Every mask eventually wears you down.
Every honest soul faces criticism.
I'd rather be misunderstood for being real, than admired for being someone I'm not.

title: I Am So Proud Of You
script_text:
I believe in you.
I believe in your dreams.
I believe in the incredible things you are going to achieve.
When you doubt yourself, I will remind you of your worth.
When you stumble, I will be the one to catch you.
And when you succeed, I will be the one cheering the loudest.
Don't ever let the world make you feel small.
Because I have seen what you are capable of.
And I am so proud of you.

title: Questions For Your Father
script_text:
Five questions to ask your father before it's too late.
Number 1, What did you feel the first time you held me in your arms?
2, What was the hardest day of your life?
3, What's something you gave up for us that we never noticed?
And 4, when the day comes that you're no longer with me, what's one thing you want me to always remember?

title: Accept People As They Are
script_text:
Accept people as they are. Place them where they belong.
You are responsible for your own life.
Acceptance frees you from trying to change anyone.
Boundaries protect your peace.
Not everyone earns the same access, the same closeness, or the same seat at your table.
And that's not cruelty. That's self-respect.

title: What Is Meant For You Cannot Pass You By
script_text:
What's meant for you cannot pass you by.
You are not late, you are not behind.
You can't lose what already belongs to your path.
Trust the timing, release what no longer fits.
Follow what feels true.
What is aligned will find you exactly when you're ready.

title: Losing You Is My Biggest Fear
script_text:
I never want to lose you, because I can't imagine a world without you.
You came into my life in a way I never expected.
You became such a special part of my world.
I can't explain how much you mean to me.
No matter how strong I try to be, the thought of losing you breaks my heart from the inside.

title: You Loved Me Anyway
script_text:
When I thought I didn't deserve love, you loved me anyway.
When all I knew was darkness, you brought me light.
When I said I was broken, you healed things you didn't break.
When I struggled to love myself, you loved me quietly.

title: Born Again
script_text:
After you walked away from me, I didn't break.
I learned to forget you.
I learned how to live without you.
And I began to love myself.
In the end, I was able to start over and begin a new life.

title: Some People Were Only Sent To Teach You
script_text:
When someone isn't right for you, life will keep using them to hurt you, until you're strong enough to let go.
And one day you'll realize,
they were only sent to teach you that losing someone is how you find yourself.

title: The Hardest Lesson I've Learned As An Adult
script_text:
The hardest lesson I've learned as an adult is that life doesn't stop, even when you're hurt.
No matter the pain, exhaustion, or loss, you still have to push through.
We grow up expecting happy endings, but find ourselves pretending to be okay instead.
Yet through it all, we find a strength we never knew we had.

title: The Best Decision I Ever Made
script_text:
The best decision I ever made was to be quiet.
I have nothing to prove.
I'm not convincing anyone that I'm a great person.
I'm not fixing what I didn't break.
I'm not fighting for anyone to see my worth.
Whatever you do is on you.
Just make sure the choices you make today are ones you can live with tomorrow.

title: Thank You For Loving Me
script_text:
Thank you for loving me.
You bring happiness into my life in ways I can't put into words.
I wish you knew how much our little talks and the time we spend together mean to me.
Every moment with you feels like a gift I never want to let go of.
I'm grateful every day for someone like you in my life.

title: What Love Feels Like
script_text:
If someone asked me what love feels like, I'd simply point to us.
With you, love isn't just a feeling.
It's the way time forgets to move when we're together.
It's the way my heart finds its way home in your presence.
And the way every dream I've quietly held somehow made room for you.

title: Be Yourself
script_text:
The moon doesn't compare itself to the stars.
The flowers don't compare themselves to other flowers.
We shouldn't compare ourselves to anyone else either.
So just be yourself.
Walk your own path quietly, and life becomes so much easier.

title: What Is Love
script_text:
What is love?
After all, it's quite simple.
Love is everything that enhances, widens, and enriches our life.
In its heights and in its depths, it makes every moment worth living.

title: Thank You For Being Such An Amazing Friend
script_text:
Thank you for being such an amazing friend, the kind I could never have asked for.
Thank you for listening to my stories and my random rants.
Thank you for always being there when I needed someone to talk to.
I'm so lucky to have a friend like you.
Just remember, I'm always here if you ever need a shoulder to lean on.

title: Trust The Process
script_text:
Sometimes the timing isn't ours to control.
But when you trust the process,
you allow the universe to guide you exactly where you're meant to be.
Every detail, every delay, it's all shaping you for something greater.
One day, you'll look back and realize, it had to happen this way.
Trust the timing, trust your growth, trust the journey.

title: I'll Always Find My Way To You
script_text:
I still hope it's you and me in the end.
My heart cannot imagine a world without you.
No matter how many years pass without us seeing each other, or how much distance stands between us,
even if the universe itself tries to keep us apart,
I will always find my way back to you.

title: Why Do They Hurt Me
script_text:
I spent so much time trying to understand why people hurt me.
I kept searching for reasons for their distance, their inconsistency.
The way they could walk away so easily without looking back.
But eventually I realized, I was giving kindness to people who never noticed how deeply they were breaking my heart.

title: I Wish You The Absolute Best
script_text:
I wish you happiness always, wherever you may be.
Even if life takes you far away from me, your presence will remain in my heart forever, unchanged.
You are no longer with me, but I still wish nothing but the very best for you.
The time we spent together has become only a memory,
but I'm so grateful someone like you was part of my life, even if only for a season.

title: My Soul Yearns For A Soul Like My Own
script_text:
My soul yearns for a soul like my own.
In this crowded world, that might be the hardest thing to find.
Someone who carries a heart full of understanding,
and still knows what it means to feel alone.
Someone who understands the way I love.

title: Choose Your Peace
script_text:
At some point, you will have to disappoint others to live a life that's honest to you.
People-pleasing will drain you, not save you.
You have every right to set boundaries and choose your peace.
You can disappoint people and still be a good person.

title: Questions For Your Mother
script_text:
Five questions to ask your mother while you still can.
What did you want to become before you had me?
What's a moment you're quietly proud of me for?
What's something you gave up for us that we never noticed?
And what's one thing you want me to always remember, after you're gone?

title: I Used Everything You Gave Me
script_text:
I read a quote that said, When I stand before God at the end of my life,
I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left and could say,
I used everything you gave me, and I hope one day I can honestly say the same.

title: Always Love You
script_text:
For every day I miss you.
For every hour I need you.
For every minute I feel you.
For every second I want you.
Forever, I love you.

title: Soulmates Recognize Each Other
script_text:
They say soulmates recognize each other instantly.
And I think that's why I felt so comfortable from the start.
I didn't need time to understand how much you meant to me.
Because my heart already knew, and it always did.

title: Not Limited To This Lifetime
script_text:
Maybe it's okay that I lost you in this life.
But I still keep hoping that somewhere in another lifetime, I'll find you again.
And in that lifetime, I'll never let you go.
We'll hold hands and walk together in peace,
never to be parted again.

title: The Heart Needs More Time
script_text:
Sometimes the heart needs more time to accept what the mind already knows.
The mind moves on the day it understands.
The heart moves on the day it stops hoping.
And between those two days, a person lives an entire life, pretending to be fine.

title: Accept People As They Are
script_text:
Accept people as they are. Place them where they belong.
You are responsible for your own life.
Acceptance frees you from trying to change anyone.
Boundaries protect your peace.
Not everyone earns the same access, the same closeness, or the same seat at your table.
And that's not cruelty. That's self-respect.

title: He Was Just Doing His Best
script_text:
As you grow older, you begin to understand.
Your father was just a man, trying his best with what he knew.
He put your needs before his own.
He traded some of his dreams for the dreams he had for you.
He was living life for the first time too.

title: Some Things Must End
script_text:
If you keep carrying old bricks, you'll keep building the same house.
New doors cannot open in rooms you never leave.
New chapters cannot begin, while you're still rereading the last page.
Tomorrow cannot arrive, while you're living in yesterday.
Some things must end, so better things can begin.

title: The Right Person
script_text:
I read somewhere that the right person won't leave you.
No matter how hard things get, they'll stay by your side.
They don't need perfect timing or easy days to prove it.
They just need you.
And honestly, that makes so much sense.

title: A Love That Feels Real
script_text:
I don't need a perfect relationship.
I just want one that feels real and safe.
No lies, no cheating, no breaking up over every little fight.
If we argue, we talk it through. If life gets hard, we face it together.
We don't walk away. We stay. That's the kind of love I want.

title: Enough Playing
script_text:
Half of life is lost charming others.
The other half is lost in the anxieties they cause.
Leave this play.
You've played enough.

title: As Adults We Understand Villains
script_text:
As kids, we love the heroes.
But as adults, we understand the villains.
Life teaches us that people aren't simply good or bad.
Sometimes the villain is just someone who got tired of being hurt,
someone who stopped explaining themselves, someone who finally chose themselves after being forgotten.

title: Some People Were Only Sent To Teach You
script_text:
When someone isn't right for you, life will keep using them to hurt you, until you're strong enough to let go.
And one day you'll realize,
they were only sent to teach you that losing someone is how you find yourself.

title: Find Your Happy Place
script_text:
In the wrong place, even your very best will never feel like enough.
But in the right place, your mere presence will be celebrated.
The same person can feel ordinary in one place, and extraordinary in another.

title: Loyalty Ends When Benefits Stop
script_text:
Once the rain is over, an umbrella becomes a burden to everyone, the day a blind man sees,
the first thing he throws away is the stick that helped him all his life.
When the sun returns,
the first thing they extinguish is the candle that guided them through the dark.
That's how loyalty ends when benefits stop.

title: Transformation
script_text:
When the right person enters your life, it's not just love, it's transformation.
They don't bring confusion or chaos. They bring calm.
They don't focus on your past. They see the strength in your scars.
They inspire you to heal and to grow.
It's not just a relationship. It's a partnership in becoming your best self.

title: We Deserve This
script_text:
This chapter of our story is called, we deserve this.
Life hasn't been gentle to either of us, and we've both carried scars from choices we once made.
But somehow, life still brought us to each other for a reason.
Now we're learning what real love feels like.
So when you see us smiling, let us smile. We deserve this.

title: I Like You vs I Love You
script_text:
What's the difference between I like you and I love you?
If you like a flower, you pick it.
If you love a flower, you care for it, water it daily, and protect it.
That's the difference between liking and loving.
And when you truly understand that difference, you understand life.

title: I'm Just Kinder To Myself
script_text:
I don't chase people anymore. I chase peace.
If you stay, I'm grateful. If you leave, I'm still peaceful.
Because I finally learned, my worth isn't proven by how hard I'm willing to suffer to be loved.
I'm not cold.
I'm just kinder to myself.

title: The Hardest Lesson I've Learned As An Adult
script_text:
The hardest lesson I've learned as an adult is that life doesn't stop, even when you're hurt.
No matter the pain, exhaustion, or loss, you still have to push through.
We grow up expecting happy endings, but find ourselves pretending to be okay instead.
Yet through it all, we find a strength we never knew we had.

title: Fluent In Hiding What I Feel
script_text:
Because I carry it well, doesn't mean it's not heavy.
I've simply become fluent in the language of pretending nothing hurts, when everything does.
I make it look effortless,
because falling apart was never an option.

title: The Hardest Battles We Fight
script_text:
One of the hardest battles we fight is between what we know and what we feel.
The truth may be simple, but feelings have never obeyed logic.
That's what makes being human so difficult.

title: Real Love Is Rare
script_text:
Do you know why real love is rare?
Because it's tested by distance, by miscommunication, by timing, by life.
But if two souls still choose each other, again and again, despite the chaos,
that's not just love.
That's unbreakable.

title: Let Me Remind You
script_text:
Let me remind you, I never want to lose you.
Life feels softer, brighter, and more beautiful with you in it.
You became the kind of person my heart feels safe with.
What I feel for you could never be explained with simple words.
No matter what life puts us through, I hope we always find our way back to each other.

title: Next Life
script_text:
I'm lucky because I found you, because I got to know the real you.
I can't imagine a world where you belong to someone else.
Please, let's never become strangers.
May the hands we're holding today never let go throughout this journey.
And even in the lives beyond this one, I hope I meet you again.

title: Remember The Lesson
script_text:
Forget the past, but remember the lesson.
Let go of what hurts you, but never forget what it taught you.
Not every loss is a failure. Some are just directions.
Learn from it. But don't let it define you.

title: Keep Building, Someone Is Waiting
script_text:
No matter how isolated or lonely you feel,
keep doing your work with honesty and quiet dedication.
Some battles are meant to be fought alone. Some chapters can only be written alone.
Someone out there is waiting to meet the person you're becoming.

title: I Love You With My Soul
script_text:
Rumi said, I love you neither with my heart, nor with my mind.
Just in case the heart might stop, the mind can forget.
I love you with my soul, soul never stops, or forgets.

title: Solitude
script_text:
A day will come when you stop chasing validation.
You stop explaining yourself, stop entertaining chaos.
And you start craving calm and peace instead.
On that day, you'll realize silence heals more than conversation ever did.
And solitude won't scare you anymore. It will feel like home.

title: Drawn To You
script_text:
I got addicted to you so quietly, drawn to you in ways I still can't explain.
Every single day, you're in my mind.
When night falls and the world turns quiet, my mind doesn't.
It fills with thoughts of you.
You're the last wish hidden inside my heart.

title: Until The Very End
script_text:
I want to see you win.
I want to see you achieve everything you aim for.
I want to be your biggest supporter, the one who protects you.
I want to be the one you need most in your hardest moments.
I want to walk with you all the way to the very end.

title: Change What Surrounds You
script_text:
I read once that you can't always change the people around you,
but you can change who you choose to be around.
And when I finally understood that,
everything made sense.

title: Thank You For Being Such An Amazing Friend
script_text:
Thank you for being such an amazing friend, the kind I could never have asked for.
Thank you for listening to my stories and my random rants.
Thank you for always being there when I needed someone to talk to.
I'm so lucky to have a friend like you.
Just remember, I'm always here if you ever need a shoulder to lean on.

title: You Might Already Be Too Late
script_text:
I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.
You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.
You heard my words. You never heard my silence.
You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.
By the time you finally understand me, it might already be too late.

title: Let People Be Exactly Who They Are
script_text:
The beginning of love is letting people be exactly who they are, not shaping them,
not fixing them into a version that makes us comfortable.
Because the moment we try to remake someone in our own image,
we stop loving them for who they are,
and start loving only the reflection of ourselves we see in them.
Real love doesn't demand a transformation.
It offers acceptance.

title: Devotion
script_text:
If someone loves you for your looks, it's obsession.
If someone loves you for your status or what you have, it's attraction.
If someone loves you for your essence, it's affection.
But if someone loves you for who you truly are,
it's devotion.

title: Losing Everything
script_text:
If you feel like you're losing everything, remember.
Trees lose their leaves every year, yet they still stand there.
Waiting quietly for better days to come.
So if life feels empty right now, maybe you're just making space.
For something beautiful to grow again.

title: Your Last Everything
script_text:
I may not be your first love, your first kiss, or your first memory.
But I want to be your last everything.
Sometimes words fall short of how deeply you live inside my heart.
If I ever did anything right, it was the moment I chose you.
You don't just complete me. You remind me of who I was always meant to be.

title: I'm Not Born To Impress Others
script_text:
I don't care what others think about me.
I'm not born to impress others.
Every mask eventually wears you down.
Every honest soul faces criticism.
I'd rather be misunderstood for being real, than admired for being someone I'm not.

title: My Soul Yearns For A Soul Like My Own
script_text:
My soul yearns for a soul like my own.
In this crowded world, that might be the hardest thing to find.
Someone who carries a heart full of understanding,
and still knows what it means to feel alone.
Someone who understands the way I love.

title: The Greatest Truth Isn't Found In Words
script_text:
The greatest truth isn't found in people's words. It's found in their actions.
Sometimes people don't tell you the truth.
Maybe they're protecting you. Maybe they're protecting themselves.
Maybe they're hiding something you'll never know.
But no matter how carefully the truth is hidden, their actions always reveal what their words conceal.

title: Maybe You'll Be Seen As The Problem
script_text:
If someone makes you feel unvalued or hurt, don't argue.
Just step back and let silence speak what words can't.
Because the moment you point out their wrongs, you'll be seen as the problem.

title: Love More
script_text:
If you love and get hurt, love more.
If you love more and hurt more, love even more.
If you love even more and hurt even more, love some more.
Until it hurts no more.

title: The Scary Thing About Distance
script_text:
The scary thing about distance is you don't know whether they'll miss you or forget you.
Maybe your name still crosses their mind before they fall asleep.
Or maybe they've already learned how to live without you.
That's what makes distance so painful.
Not the miles, but the silence, the uncertainty, and slowly becoming a memory to someone you still think about every day.

title: What Is Love
script_text:
What is love?
It's giving someone the complete power to change your life.
It can bring hope, build you up, or sometimes destroy you completely.
The one who loves you can bring a smile to your face with the smallest things,
or break you entirely. Is this truly what love means?

title: Understanding Is Art
script_text:
Understanding is art, and not everyone is an artist.
Some paint with their eyes. Some paint with their ego.
Only a few paint with their heart.
The greatest works are never hung on walls.
They live quietly inside people's hearts.

title: Questions For Your Mother
script_text:
Five questions to ask your mother while you still can.
What did you want to become before you had me?
What's a moment you're quietly proud of me for?
What's something you gave up for us that we never noticed?
And what's one thing you want me to always remember, after you're gone?

title: We Suffer More In Imagination
script_text:
We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
We live inside our heads all the time.
It doesn't matter what the reality actually is.
The problem is we overthink everything.
Most of our pain doesn't come from what happens, but from what we imagine might happen.

title: Once You Decide You Want A Good Life
script_text:
Once you decide you want a good life,
the universe will start moving things for you to have it.
The people you need will appear, the healing you need will happen.
The doors you need open will unlock, but not till you decide.
Once you truly, sincerely decide, miracles will happen.

title: He Breaks For Love Only Once
script_text:
A legend says a man truly breaks for love only once.
After that light goes out, he spends his life chasing its reflection in the faces of strangers.
He may search for her in everyone he meets.
But the deepest part of his heart stays locked in a past he can never return to.

title: Until My Last Breath
script_text:
In this journey we call life, we face so many different paths and choices.
But in every single moment, you are the one I choose.
So many things in my life might be uncertain,
but one thing is very clear.
I will keep choosing you and loving you until my very last breath.

title: You Loved Me Anyway
script_text:
When I thought I didn't deserve love, you loved me anyway.
When all I knew was darkness, you brought me light.
When I said I was broken, you healed things you didn't break.
When I struggled to love myself, you loved me quietly.

title: Why That Happens Every Time
script_text:
I forgive people easily. I trust people easily.
I forget the bad things they did easily.
I always believe they'll be different this time.
I keep giving chances they never deserve, and I see the good in people, even when they show me the worst.
And somehow, I end up being the one who gets hurt, every single time.

title: The Heart Needs More Time
script_text:
Sometimes the heart needs more time to accept what the mind already knows.
The mind moves on the day it understands.
The heart moves on the day it stops hoping.
And between those two days, a person lives an entire life, pretending to be fine.

title: Your Wound Is Not Your Fault
script_text:
Your wound is not your fault, but your healing is your responsibility.
No one can rewrite your past, but you can decide how your story continues.
Heal, so the pain ends with you, not with the people you love.

title: The Only Way To Impress Me
script_text:
The only way to impress me is by being a good person.
I don't care what you have, what you wear, where you live, or what you drive.
I just have deep respect for people with pure hearts and good intentions.

title: You Meet The People You're Meant To Meet
script_text:
There is a legend that says you meet the people you're meant to meet.
Not by accident, not by chance, but by something your soul agreed to keep.
Some will come to heal you.
Some will come to break you.
But the ones who stay through both are the ones written in your heart.

title: I Still Believe In Us
script_text:
I still hope it's you and me in the end.
No matter how much has changed, or how many different paths life has led us down,
a part of me still believes in us.
It isn't just a wish. It's something I'm holding onto with everything I have.
My feelings for you never faded, and my heart still knows you're the only one who belongs by my side.

title: What Love Feels Like
script_text:
If someone asked me what love feels like, I'd simply point to us.
With you, love isn't just a feeling.
It's the way time forgets to move when we're together.
It's the way my heart finds its way home in your presence.
And the way every dream I've quietly held somehow made room for you.

title: Your Best Chapter Is Still Waiting
script_text:
If you're strong enough to fall in love and give everything you have,
you're strong enough to let it all go.
Strong enough to pick up your pieces and start over.
Because the end of one story is never the end of your story.
Your best chapter is still waiting to be written.

title: He Was Just Doing His Best
script_text:
As you grow older, you begin to understand.
Your father was just a man, trying his best with what he knew.
He put your needs before his own.
He traded some of his dreams for the dreams he had for you.
He was living life for the first time too.

title: Life Has Taught Me
script_text:
Life has taught me, you can't decide how loyal someone will be.
Treating people with love and respect doesn't guarantee they'll return it.
Caring deeply for someone doesn't mean they'll care for you the same way.
The saddest truth is, the people closest to you can become the ones you feel safest keeping your distance from.

title: The Journey
script_text:
There is a legend that says, if you get on the wrong train, get off at the nearest station.
The longer it takes you to leave, the more expensive the return trip becomes.
Every stop you stay past your peace is a cost you'll have to pay back.
So is this really only about trains?

title: More Than Words Can Hold
script_text:
I didn't fall in love with just your smile.
I fell for your voice, the way it softens when you speak to me.
I fell for your laugh, the one that brightens even my darkest days.
I fell in love with how you love me, gently, deeply, completely.
It's who you are that stole my heart, and I love you more than words can hold.

title: Why Do They Hurt Me
script_text:
I spent so much time trying to understand why people hurt me.
I kept searching for reasons for their distance, their inconsistency.
The way they could walk away so easily without looking back.
But eventually I realized, I was giving kindness to people who never noticed how deeply they were breaking my heart.

title: True People Won't Need Convincing
script_text:
It hurts when your biggest effort is ignored, and your smallest mistake is judged.
People often remember one mistake, and forget a hundred sacrifices.
Don't waste your life trying to prove yourself to everyone.
Peace begins the moment you stop seeking everyone's approval.
The people who truly matter never needed convincing.

title: As Adults We Understand Villains
script_text:
As kids, we love the heroes.
But as adults, we understand the villains.
Life teaches us that people aren't simply good or bad.
Sometimes the villain is just someone who got tired of being hurt,
someone who stopped explaining themselves, someone who finally chose themselves after being forgotten.

title: Sometimes You Just Have To Accept It
script_text:
Sometimes you just have to accept the situation.
Understand that it's okay. It happens. It's life.
Not every ending needs an explanation.
Not every loss deserves another chance.
Some chapters are only meant to teach, not to stay.
And one day, you'll thank life for what it didn't let you keep.

title: Lost With You
script_text:
Lost with you in you and without you.
Before you, after you, somehow, still around you.
Not by chance, not by choice, but by a love that never learned to leave.

title: Freedom Or Loneliness
I Chose To Stay
script_text:
I can't force you to love me, because love was never meant to be forced.
It has to come from your own heart.
But there's one thing I need you to know.
I will always be here, not because I have to, but because I chose to.
No matter how much time passes, somewhere inside my heart, a part of me is still waiting for you.

title: Soulmates Recognize Each Other
script_text:
They say soulmates recognize each other instantly.
And I think that's why I felt so comfortable from the start.
I didn't need time to understand how much you meant to me.
Because my heart already knew, and it always did.

title: A Soul Your Own Has Always Known
script_text:
There is a legend that says when you meet your soulmate,
you'll feel a sudden sense of calm and peace,
as if you've finally come home after a very long journey.
And in their eyes, you'll recognize a soul your own has always known.

title: Find Your Happy Place
script_text:
In the wrong place, even your very best will never feel like enough.
But in the right place, your mere presence will be celebrated.
The same person can feel ordinary in one place, and extraordinary in another.

title: Never Get Too Attached
script_text:
Never get too attached to anyone who doesn't feel the same about you.
Because one-sided expectations can quietly destroy you.
Some people become your whole world, while you remain just a chapter in theirs.
So choose wisely. Choose yourself.

title: A Lot Of Things Made Sense
script_text:
I read a quote that said, Observe, but don't absorb.
Love, but don't depend.
Want, but don't need.
Feel, but don't dwell.
Give, but don't expect.
Speak, but don't hurt.
And suddenly, a lot of things made sense.

title: Faith
script_text:
Please don't give up on us.
What we have means more to me than words can explain.
I know life isn't always easy, but I'm still trying my best for us.
We might have our issues, but my feelings for you are completely real.
Even when everything else feels uncertain, the one thing I still have absolute faith in is us.

title: Fortunate To Be With You
script_text:
You are the most beautiful person I've ever seen.
You are the strongest person I know.
You are the kindest person I've ever met.
You are the brightest light I've ever found.
I feel so fortunate to have the chance to be with you.

title: A Love That Feels Real
script_text:
I don't need a perfect relationship.
I just want one that feels real and safe.
No lies, no cheating, no breaking up over every little fight.
If we argue, we talk it through. If life gets hard, we face it together.
We don't walk away. We stay. That's the kind of love I want.

title: You Feel Like A Part Of Me
script_text:
I wasn't looking for you when I met you.
But now, with you, it feels like a part of me always wanted this.
My heart stopped searching for anything else,
the moment it found you.

title: I'm Just Kinder To Myself
script_text:
I don't chase people anymore. I chase peace.
If you stay, I'm grateful. If you leave, I'm still peaceful.
Because I finally learned, my worth isn't proven by how hard I'm willing to suffer to be loved.
I'm not cold.
I'm just kinder to myself.

title: The Only Moment You Can Shape
script_text:
No amount of regret rewrites yesterday.
No amount of worry controls tomorrow.
No guilt can undo what's already happened.
No overthinking has ever brought peace.
The only moment you can shape is this one.
Live it with intention. Make it beautiful.

title: Lovers Don't Finally Meet Somewhere
script_text:
Rumi said, The minute I heard my first love story, I started looking for you.
Not knowing how blind that was.
Lovers don't finally meet somewhere.
They're in each other all along.
What seems like a beginning is a revelation.
What seems like a meeting is recognition.

title: In This Life, You Will Realize
script_text:
In this life, you'll realize there's a purpose for every person you meet.
Some will test you, some will use you.
Some will teach you, and some will bring out the best in you.
A single choice can change your entire life.

title: Isn't It Strange
script_text:
Isn't it strange?
You are not the same person you once were.
Too much has changed. Too much had to.
So don't expect from yourself what you once embodied.
That version of you no longer exists. Maybe what you lost shaped you, and what you buried set you free.

title: We Deserve This
script_text:
This chapter of our story is called, we deserve this.
Life hasn't been gentle to either of us, and we've both carried scars from choices we once made.
But somehow, life still brought us to each other for a reason.
Now we're learning what real love feels like.
So when you see us smiling, let us smile. We deserve this.

title: Fluent In Hiding What I Feel
script_text:
Because I carry it well, doesn't mean it's not heavy.
I've simply become fluent in the language of pretending nothing hurts, when everything does.
I make it look effortless,
because falling apart was never an option.

title: The Next Page
script_text:
Your next move matters.
More than your last mistake.
The past can teach you, but it cannot define you.
What happens next is still in your hands.
Don't let one bad chapter convince you the story is over.
The next page could change everything.

title: Always Be Ready
script_text:
Always be ready to survive alone.
Some people suddenly change.
Today you're important to them, tomorrow you might be nothing.
Sometimes they only held you for their own benefit.
That's the ultimate truth of life.

title: I Can't Lie, I Miss You
script_text:
I can't lie, I miss you more with each passing day.
Your absence leaves a void nothing else can fill.
I miss the way you make me feel so loved and special.
I miss our conversations, your laughter, the comfort of knowing you're near.
Life feels a bit off without you, and until we're together again, know you're always in my heart.

title: Let Me Remind You
script_text:
Let me remind you, I never want to lose you.
Life feels softer, brighter, and more beautiful with you in it.
You became the kind of person my heart feels safe with.
What I feel for you could never be explained with simple words.
No matter what life puts us through, I hope we always find our way back to each other.

title: Remember The Lesson
script_text:
Forget the past, but remember the lesson.
Let go of what hurts you, but never forget what it taught you.
Not every loss is a failure. Some are just directions.
Learn from it. But don't let it define you.

title: That's Life
script_text:
Imagine reading a book with no way to turn back the page.
How carefully would you read it?
That's life.
Every moment passes once.
Every word leaves a mark.
So choose what matters before it becomes a memory.

title: The Past Is Done
script_text:
Accept what happened. The past is done.
You can't go back and change it, no matter how much you want to.
What you can do is stop letting it control your present.
Accept it, and learn from it.
Don't let the past be your whole story. Let it be just one chapter.

title: All Of Me
script_text:
I hope you know there isn't anyone who gets my attention the way you do.
I'm all in for you.
There isn't anyone who can keep me up all night, thinking about them the entire day,
the way that I do for you.

title: Drawn To You
script_text:
I got addicted to you so quietly, drawn to you in ways I still can't explain.
Every single day, you're in my mind.
When night falls and the world turns quiet, my mind doesn't.
It fills with thoughts of you.
You're the last wish hidden inside my heart.

title: Keep Building, Someone Is Waiting
script_text:
No matter how isolated or lonely you feel,
keep doing your work with honesty and quiet dedication.
Some battles are meant to be fought alone. Some chapters can only be written alone.
Someone out there is waiting to meet the person you're becoming.

title: Without Changing A Single Petal
script_text:
You can be the prettiest rose ever.
But if they like lilies, it wouldn't matter.
So don't question your beauty.
Some people simply can't appreciate what was never meant for them.
You'll be someone's favorite flower, without changing a single petal.

title: This Is My Promise
script_text:
Dear love, I may not be your first love, but I promise to be your last.
I promise to bring back the smile that faded from your face long ago.
I promise to fill your world with happiness once again.
No matter what storms come our way,
I will be with you forever.

title: A Deeper Love
script_text:
Real love happens in two moments.
First, you fall for who they appear to be, the charm, the smile, the feeling.
Then the truth unfolds. You see their flaws, their past, their struggles.
If you choose to stay, to understand, to love them as they are,
that's not attraction anymore. That's a deeper love, the kind that lasts.

title: Losing Everything
script_text:
If you feel like you're losing everything, remember.
Trees lose their leaves every year, yet they still stand there.
Waiting quietly for better days to come.
So if life feels empty right now, maybe you're just making space.
For something beautiful to grow again.

title: Change What Surrounds You
script_text:
I read once that you can't always change the people around you,
but you can change who you choose to be around.
And when I finally understood that,
everything made sense.

title: Look At Yourself And Remember Me
script_text:
Rumi said, You have no idea how hard I've looked for a gift to bring you.
Nothing seemed right.
What's the point of bringing gold to a gold mine or water to the ocean?
Everything I came up with was like taking spices to the Orient.
It's no good giving my heart and my soul because you already have these.
So I've brought you a mirror.
Look at yourself and remember me.

title: Our Kind Of Love
script_text:
Do you know the most beautiful thing about our love?
It happened so purely, I never even imagined it in my dreams.
We didn't plan this love, and that's exactly why it's so special.
No rules, no boundaries, just two hearts coming together naturally.
It's more than love. It's peace. It's home.

title: Unconditional
script_text:
Can love truly be unconditional?
I believe yes.
Because unconditional love isn't a transaction. It's a sanctuary.
It's the rare, brave choice to see someone's deepest shadows and shattered pieces,
yet decide to stay and love them anyway.

title: The Scary Thing About Distance
script_text:
The scary thing about distance is you don't know whether they'll miss you or forget you.
Maybe your name still crosses their mind before they fall asleep.
Or maybe they've already learned how to live without you.
That's what makes distance so painful.
Not the miles, but the silence, the uncertainty, and slowly becoming a memory to someone you still think about every day.

title: You Might Already Be Too Late
script_text:
I was too tired to explain, so I chose silence.
You kept asking what was wrong. I kept saying nothing.
You heard my words. You never heard my silence.
You wanted an explanation. I wanted to be understood.
By the time you finally understand me, it might already be too late.

title: Roses Are Not Always Red
script_text:
Roses are not always red, and violets are not always blue.
The people who say they love you, are not always the ones who do.
Goodbye is not always the end, and forever is not always true.
Sometimes the hardest part of love is accepting, I was not meant for you.

title: Love Is About Effort
script_text:
Love isn't just about what's comfortable for you.
It's about learning the language of the person you choose.
It takes effort, patience, and emotional maturity.
It won't always be easy.
Real love blooms when both people learn to love each other, not just themselves.

title: I Felt Peace
script_text:
I didn't fall for you because I wanted a relationship.
I fell for you because, for the first time in forever, I felt peace.
Like I was finally home.
I fell for your smile, the way you made my heart laugh,
and the way you never let me wonder if I was wanted.

title: Until My Last Breath
script_text:
In this journey we call life, we face so many different paths and choices.
But in every single moment, you are the one I choose.
So many things in my life might be uncertain,
but one thing is very clear.
I will keep choosing you and loving you until my very last breath.

title: I'm Not Born To Impress Others
script_text:
I don't care what others think about me.
I'm not born to impress others.
Every mask eventually wears you down.
Every honest soul faces criticism.
I'd rather be misunderstood for being real, than admired for being someone I'm not.

title: Real Eyes Realize Real Lies
script_text:
Real eyes realize real lies.
Wise minds recognize disguise signs.
Pure hearts prioritize true ties.
False smiles often hide dark sides.
Time flies, exposing every disguise.
And the deepest scars come from trusted lies.

title: The Train
script_text:
Life is just a journey on a train, with a pair of travelers at every window.
Sometimes someone stays right beside you for the whole ride.
Sometimes they step off along the way.
But if destiny ever seats me next to you,
let's be pleasant travelers. It's such a short journey.

title: Complete Yourself
script_text:
A soulmate is not someone who completes you.
They're someone who encourages you to complete yourself.
They understand and love you despite your flaws, because they don't define you by them.
They help guide you to your true potential, your genuine self,
because they recognize what an amazing person you already are.

title: I Still Believe In Us
script_text:
I still hope it's you and me in the end.
No matter how much has changed, or how many different paths life has led us down,
a part of me still believes in us.
It isn't just a wish. It's something I'm holding onto with everything I have.
My feelings for you never faded, and my heart still knows you're the only one who belongs by my side.

title: The Greatest Truth Isn't Found In Words
script_text:
The greatest truth isn't found in people's words. It's found in their actions.
Sometimes people don't tell you the truth.
Maybe they're protecting you. Maybe they're protecting themselves.
Maybe they're hiding something you'll never know.
But no matter how carefully the truth is hidden, their actions always reveal what their words conceal.

title: Do You Know Why Real Love Is Rare
script_text:
Do you know why real love is rare?
Because it's tested by distance, by miscommunication, by timing, by life.
But if two souls still choose each other again and again, despite the chaos,
that's not just love.
That's unbreakable.

title: Hope
script_text:
I hope you know, distance never separates two hearts that really care.
Our memories span the miles, and in seconds we're there.
Whenever I start feeling sad because I miss you,
I remind myself how lucky I am to have someone so special to miss.

title: Take Care Of Your Soul
script_text:
Be with someone who takes care of you.
Not just materially, but your soul, your well-being, your heart.
Someone who sees all of you, and still chooses to stay.
That's the kind of care worth waiting for.

title: More Than Words Can Hold
script_text:
I didn't fall in love with just your smile.
I fell for your voice, the way it softens when you speak to me.
I fell for your laugh, the one that brightens even my darkest days.
I fell in love with how you love me, gently, deeply, completely.
It's who you are that stole my heart, and I love you more than words can hold.

title: Understanding Is Art
script_text:
Understanding is art, and not everyone is an artist.
Some paint with their eyes. Some paint with their ego.
Only a few paint with their heart.
The greatest works are never hung on walls.
They live quietly inside people's hearts.

title: What Is The Difference
script_text:
What is the difference between I like you and I love you?
When you like a flower, you just pluck it.
But when you love a flower, you water it daily.
One who understands this understands life.

title: What I Read
script_text:
I read something once that stayed with me.
Observe, but don't absorb. Love, but don't depend.
Give, but don't expect. Speak, but don't hurt.
Because life isn't about holding on to everything.
It's about knowing what to carry, and what to let go.

title: It's Always You
script_text:
I think about you a lot, all the time.
In the morning when I wake, at night before I sleep.
Even in the middle of my day when I'm busy,
you quietly come into my thoughts.
No matter where I am, my heart always comes back to you. It's always you.

title: I Chose To Stay
script_text:
I can't force you to love me, because love was never meant to be forced.
It has to come from your own heart.
But there's one thing I need you to know.
I will always be here, not because I have to, but because I chose to.
No matter how much time passes, somewhere inside my heart, a part of me is still waiting for you.

title: We Suffer More In Imagination
script_text:
We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
We live inside our heads all the time.
It doesn't matter what the reality actually is.
The problem is we overthink everything.
Most of our pain doesn't come from what happens, but from what we imagine might happen.

title: You Meet The People You're Meant To Meet
script_text:
There is a Japanese legend that says, you meet the people you're meant to meet.
Not by accident, not by chance, but by something your soul agreed to keep.
Some will come to heal you.
Some will come to break you.
But the ones who stay through both are the ones who are written in your heart.

title: Old Love, New Face
script_text:
There is a legend that says the face you have now once belonged to the person you loved most in a past life.
Every time you look at yourself, you're looking at your old love.
Maybe that's why some eyes feel strangely familiar.
Love never truly leaves.
It simply changes its face.

title: Favorite
script_text:
Your name is my favorite word.
Your voice is my favorite sound.
Your eyes are my favorite mirror.
Your arms are my favorite place.
And your love is my favorite feeling.

title: Fortunate To Be With You
script_text:
You are the most beautiful person I've ever seen.
You are the strongest person I know.
You are the kindest person I've ever met.
You are the brightest light I've ever found.
I feel so fortunate to have the chance to be with you.

title: Why That Happens Every Time
script_text:
I forgive people easily. I trust people easily.
I forget the bad things they did easily.
I always believe they'll be different this time.
I keep giving chances they never deserve, and I see the good in people, even when they show me the worst.
And somehow, I end up being the one who gets hurt, every single time.

title: Everything Happens For A Reason
script_text:
Everything happens for a reason.
The people who come in and the ones who leave.
None of it is random.
Every moment carries a lesson.
Every lesson is guiding you closer to your purpose.
So when life feels heavy, there's meaning in this too.

title: The Sun And The Moon
script_text:
There is a legend that says the sun and the moon once loved each other.
But because of time and distance, they were never meant to meet.
So the universe created the eclipse, so they could meet again, if only for a moment.
To prove there's no such thing as an impossible love.
Because even the most distant hearts meet, if only once.

title: Maybe
script_text:
Maybe love isn't what we've been told.
Maybe it's not all romance or attraction.
Maybe love is a friend, someone who understands you.
Someone who's there for you, even at your worst.

title: Isn't It Strange
script_text:
Isn't it strange?
You are not the same person you once were.
Too much has changed. Too much had to.
So don't expect from yourself what you once embodied.
That version of you no longer exists. Maybe what you lost shaped you, and what you buried set you free.

title: Your Wound Is Not Your Fault
script_text:
Your wound is not your fault, but your healing is your responsibility.
No one can rewrite your past, but you can decide how your story continues.
Heal, so the pain ends with you, not with the people you love.

title: How Do I Trust You
script_text:
Once you lie to me, every truth you ever told me holds less value.
How am I supposed to distinguish black from white when you have painted everything grey?
And how do I trust your light when even your shadows lie?

title: I Want To Be The One
script_text:
I want to be your person.
The one who is always with you.
The one who always supports you.
And the one who becomes your last love.

title: Your Eyes
script_text:
Your eyes are the color of the ocean, laced with sunlight.
They shine with every beautiful shade of your being.
I love the person I am when you look at me.
And I'll never find the words to thank you for that.

title: I Can't Lie, I Miss You
script_text:
I can't lie, I miss you more with each passing day.
Your absence leaves a void nothing else can fill.
I miss the way you make me feel so loved and special.
I miss our conversations, your laughter, the comfort of knowing you're near.
Life feels a bit off without you, and until we're together again, know you're always in my heart.

title: Your Best Chapter Is Still Waiting
script_text:
If you're strong enough to fall in love and give everything you have,
you're strong enough to let it all go.
Strong enough to pick up your pieces and start over.
Because the end of one story is never the end of your story.
Your best chapter is still waiting to be written.

title: Happiness Is A Choice
script_text:
Happiness is a choice, not a result.
Nothing will make you happy until you choose to be happy.
No person will make you happy unless you decide to be happy.
Your happiness will not come to you.
It can only come from you.

title: When Two Souls Meet
script_text:
I read once that two souls never meet by accident.
There's always a reason, a connection that transcends time and distance.
Whether it's fate or destiny, if two people are meant to meet, nothing can stop it.
Their meeting is part of something greater than themselves.
And it unfolds at exactly the right time.

title: How Incredible You Are
script_text:
I want to make you so happy you can't stop smiling.
I want you to feel so loved you never have to doubt anything.
As I keep learning new things about you,
I want to prove just how incredible I think you are.

title: All Of Me
script_text:
I hope you know there isn't anyone who gets my attention the way you do.
I'm all in for you.
There isn't anyone who can keep me up all night, thinking about them the entire day,
the way that I do for you.

title: Life Has Taught Me
script_text:
Life has taught me, you can't decide how loyal someone will be.
Treating people with love and respect doesn't guarantee they'll return it.
Caring deeply for someone doesn't mean they'll care for you the same way.
The saddest truth is, the people closest to you can become the ones you feel safest keeping your distance from.

title: How Can Someone Be So Careless With A Heart
script_text:
You don't like hurting people's hearts.
Yet some people hurt yours.
Without even thinking twice, don't they?
And sometimes you sit there wondering, how can someone be so careless with a heart?
Maybe that's the saddest part of being kind.
You expect others to carry your feelings, but the same softness.
You carried this.

title: First Thought, Last Thought
script_text:
What a beautiful thing it is to be someone's first thought in the morning, and their last at night.
It isn't just romance. It's safety.
In a world full of noise, you live in the quiet corners of their mind.
You're their anchor before the chaos begins, and their calm when it ends.
It's rare, and it's sacred.

title: Mutually Satisfying Weirdness
script_text:
I read somewhere that we're all a little weird, and life is a little weird too.
And when we find someone whose weirdness is compatible with ours,
we join up with them,
and fall into mutually satisfying weirdness.
And we call it love.

title: A Deeper Love
script_text:
Real love happens in two moments.
First, you fall for who they appear to be, the charm, the smile, the feeling.
Then the truth unfolds. You see their flaws, their past, their struggles.
If you choose to stay, to understand, to love them as they are,
that's not attraction anymore. That's a deeper love, the kind that lasts.

title: True People Won't Need Convincing
script_text:
It hurts when your biggest effort is ignored, and your smallest mistake is judged.
People often remember one mistake, and forget a hundred sacrifices.
Don't waste your life trying to prove yourself to everyone.
Peace begins the moment you stop seeking everyone's approval.
The people who truly matter never needed convincing.

title: Do Not Be A Beggar Of Love
script_text:
Rumi said, Do not be a beggar of love.
Be a giver of love.
A beautiful person is not always good, But a good person is always beautiful.
Be the kind of soul that gives love without begging for it.

title: People Are Like Books
script_text:
People are like books.
Some deceive you with their cover, others surprise you with their content.
So don't chase appearances.
Time always reveals what words cannot.
And the right people will prove themselves without effort.

title: I Promise
script_text:
You are the most amazing person I have ever known.
Your love fills my heart with joy, and my soul with peace.
I'm so grateful for the way you love me, and the way you make me feel.
You are my everything, and I am so blessed to have you.
I promise to love you deeply and completely, for all the days of my life.

title: Unconditional
script_text:
Can love truly be unconditional?
I believe yes.
Because unconditional love isn't a transaction. It's a sanctuary.
It's the rare, brave choice to see someone's deepest shadows and shattered pieces,
yet decide to stay and love them anyway.

title: Sometimes You Just Have To Accept It
script_text:
Sometimes you just have to accept the situation.
Understand that it's okay. It happens. It's life.
Not every ending needs an explanation.
Not every loss deserves another chance.
Some chapters are only meant to teach, not to stay.
And one day, you'll thank life for what it didn't let you keep.

title: Lovable To Everyone
script_text:
Dostoevsky said, I gave them every version of myself, hoping one would be enough.
And Franz Kafka said, but people only love the version they don't have to fix.
So in the end, the most exhausting thing in life is trying to be lovable to everyone.

title: I Didn't Fall In Love Because I Was Lonely
script_text:
I didn't fall in love with you because I was lonely or lost.
I fell in love with you after getting to know you.
After I truly understood who you are.
I realized I wanted to make you a permanent part of my world.

title: My Only Refuge
script_text:
You are my only protection, all my joy, all my hope, my only refuge.
When we're apart, I feel like I've been cut in two.
My love for you isn't just great. It's infinite.
It's the only thing that keeps me alive in this world.

title: I Felt Peace
script_text:
I didn't fall for you because I wanted a relationship.
I fell for you because, for the first time in forever, I felt peace.
Like I was finally home.
I fell for your smile, the way you made my heart laugh,
and the way you never let me wonder if I was wanted.

title: A Soul Your Own Has Always Known
script_text:
There is a legend that says when you meet your soulmate,
you'll feel a sudden sense of calm and peace,
as if you've finally come home after a very long journey.
And in their eyes, you'll recognize a soul your own has always known.

title: Breathe And Allow Things To Pass
script_text:
The truth is, you will continue to suffer.
If you have an emotional reaction to everything that is said to you.
True power is sitting back and observing things with logic.
True power is restraint.
If words control you, that means everyone else can control you.
Breathe and allow things to pass.

title: Three Faces
script_text:
There is a legend that says we all have three faces.
The first, we show to the world.
The second, we reveal only to the people we trust most, and to our family.
And the final one is the one we keep hidden.
It's our truest self, the person we really are.

title: You Made My Heart Believe Again
script_text:
You'll never understand how deeply your existence changed my heart, and made it believe again.
You'll never truly know the healing you brought to my scattered mind.
I'll tell you anyway, over and over, even as my hair begins to grey,
how remarkable your soul is.
Because through the adventure of being loved by you, I finally know how a heart feels when it's home.

title: Complete Yourself
script_text:
A soulmate is not someone who completes you.
They're someone who encourages you to complete yourself.
They understand and love you despite your flaws, because they don't define you by them.
They help guide you to your true potential, your genuine self,
because they recognize what an amazing person you already are.

title: Never Get Too Attached
script_text:
Never get too attached to anyone who doesn't feel the same about you.
Because one-sided expectations can quietly destroy you.
Some people become your whole world, while you remain just a chapter in theirs.
So choose wisely. Choose yourself.

title: Never Lose Your Depth
script_text:
If you are an ocean, be an ocean.
Don't be a pond, just because people can't swim.
Some will fear your waves, some will doubt your tide.
But never lose your depth, just to stand beside them.

title: A Song Only You Can Hear
script_text:
You don't love someone for their looks, or their clothes, or their car.
You love them because they sing a song only you can hear.
Love is something deeper than what the eyes can see.
It's something only the heart can feel.

title: Undress My Soul
script_text:
Undress my soul.
Open every folded petal.
Dig into the bark of my strength.
Search the artifacts of my heart.
Before soaking my body in your eyes, and your touch.

title: Take Care Of Your Soul
script_text:
Be with someone who takes care of you.
Not just materially, but your soul, your well-being, your heart.
Someone who sees all of you, and still chooses to stay.
That's the kind of care worth waiting for.

title: You Feel Like A Part Of Me
script_text:
I wasn't looking for you when I met you.
But now, with you, it feels like a part of me always wanted this.
My heart stopped searching for anything else,
the moment it found you.

title: I'm Still Waiting
script_text:
I'm still waiting for you.
Because my heart feels like there's something special between us.
Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow.
But I feel like it's worth waiting for.
Deep down, I believe one day we'll find our way back to each other.

title: It's Always You
script_text:
I think about you a lot, all the time.
In the morning when I wake, at night before I sleep.
Even in the middle of my day when I'm busy,
you quietly come into my thoughts.
No matter where I am, my heart always comes back to you. It's always you.

title: The Only Moment You Can Shape
script_text:
No amount of regret rewrites yesterday.
No amount of worry controls tomorrow.
No guilt can undo what's already happened.
No overthinking has ever brought peace.
The only moment you can shape is this one.
Live it with intention. Make it beautiful.

title: The Truth Of Love
script_text:
So the truth about love is...
The one who longs for it never gets it.
The one who gets it, never values it.
The one who loses it, never forget it, never forget it.
Never really had it.

title: The Saddest Thing
script_text:
Do you know the saddest thing in life?
It's meeting the right person at the wrong time.
Two people can truly care for each other,
but life may keep them apart before they're ready.
And some of the deepest connections become memories, simply because the timing was never right.

title: Favorite
script_text:
Your name is my favorite word.
Your voice is my favorite sound.
Your eyes are my favorite mirror.
Your arms are my favorite place.
And your love is my favorite feeling.

title: You Deserve The Same Love You Give To Others
script_text:
Give love, but don't exhaust yourself.
Be peaceful, but don't become passive.
Be kind, but don't let people misuse you.
Stay humble, but know your worth.
Be patient, but don't wait forever.
Protect yourself.
You deserve the same love you give to others.

title: No One Matches Perfectly
script_text:
People say you can't find someone who completely matches you.
I believe that's true, because no one in this world matches another person in every way.
We learn to accept our differences and grow together despite them.
A relationship grows stronger when two people accept each other's flaws,
and choose to love one another anyway.

title: Maybe
script_text:
Maybe love isn't what we've been told.
Maybe it's not all romance or attraction.
Maybe love is a friend, someone who understands you.
Someone who's there for you, even at your worst.

title: This Is My Promise To You
script_text:
Dear Love, maybe I'm too late to be your first love, but I'll do anything to be your last.
I'll become the reason your soul slowly learns happiness again.
I'll become a part of the most beautiful chapter of your life, not for a moment,
but forever.
And this is my promise to you.

title: Silent
script_text:
I still love you silently.
Even when there are no words left to say, my love for you hasn't faded.
Not everything I feel needs to be spoken.
Some love is felt more deeply than it's said.
You're still present in the quietest parts of my days, and my heart is still choosing you in silence.

title: Your Eyes
script_text:
Your eyes are the color of the ocean, laced with sunlight.
They shine with every beautiful shade of your being.
I love the person I am when you look at me.
And I'll never find the words to thank you for that.

title: You Decide The Value Of Your Life
script_text:
Time decides who you meet in life.
Your heart decides who you want in your life.
Your behavior decides who stays in your life.
Your choices decide the direction of your life.
Your mindset decides the peace in your life.
And you decide the value of your life.

title: They Say
script_text:
They say finding someone who truly understands you is rare.
And that kind of connection can't be measured by time.
Because love isn't about how long you've been together.
It's about how much you choose each other.

title: How Incredible You Are
script_text:
I want to make you so happy you can't stop smiling.
I want you to feel so loved you never have to doubt anything.
As I keep learning new things about you,
I want to prove just how incredible I think you are.

title: Power Isn't In Proving
script_text:
You know what?
When they insult, stay silent but smile.
When they lie, let truth unfold on its own.
When they shout, lower your tone.
When they blame, don't defend, just observe.
Power isn't in proving.
It's in knowing you don't need to.

title: Truth Or Illusion
script_text:
Some say it's better to suffer and know the truth than to be happy inside a delusion.
Others say they'd rather keep their illusions, because illusions are often kinder than the truth.
So which are you?
Do you want the truth?
Or do you want the illusion?

title: Mutually Satisfying Weirdness
script_text:
I read somewhere that we're all a little weird, and life is a little weird too.
And when we find someone whose weirdness is compatible with ours,
we join up with them,
and fall into mutually satisfying weirdness.
And we call it love.

title: What Is Love
script_text:
I read a quote that said,
love is giving someone enough power to completely destroy your life and trusting that they
never will.
And honestly, I don't think love has ever been explained better than that.

title: I Hope You Know
script_text:
I hope you know you make me happy.
I know it sounds simple, but I mean it from the heart.
A regular day becomes beautiful when I spend it with you.
You make me believe in love again.
We fight, we make up, we talk, we comfort each other, and in all these little things, I feel how much love there is.

title: I Promise
script_text:
You are the most amazing person I have ever known.
Your love fills my heart with joy, and my soul with peace.
I'm so grateful for the way you love me, and the way you make me feel.
You are my everything, and I am so blessed to have you.
I promise to love you deeply and completely, for all the days of my life.

title: Rumi Said
script_text:
Rumi said, Try not to resist the changes that come your way.
Instead, let life live through you.
And do not worry that your life is turning upside down.
How do you know that the side you are used to?
Is better than the one to come?

title: Born Again
script_text:
After you walked away from me, I didn't break.
I learned to forget you.
I learned how to live without you.
And I began to love myself.
In the end, I was able to start over and begin a new life.

title: My Only Refuge
script_text:
You are my only protection, all my joy, all my hope, my only refuge.
When we're apart, I feel like I've been cut in two.
My love for you isn't just great. It's infinite.
It's the only thing that keeps me alive in this world.

title: What Do You Prefer
script_text:
Franz Kafka said,
"...there are times when I'm convinced I'm unfit for any human relationships.
But Dostoevsky said, I want to talk about everything with at least one person,
as I talk about things with myself.
So the question is, do you prefer solitude?
Or do you prefer intimacy?

title: Be Yourself
script_text:
The moon doesn't compare itself to the stars.
The flowers don't compare themselves to other flowers.
We shouldn't compare ourselves to anyone else either.
So just be yourself.
Walk your own path quietly, and life becomes so much easier.

title: You Made My Heart Believe Again
script_text:
You'll never understand how deeply your existence changed my heart, and made it believe again.
You'll never truly know the healing you brought to my scattered mind.
I'll tell you anyway, over and over, even as my hair begins to grey,
how remarkable your soul is.
Because through the adventure of being loved by you, I finally know how a heart feels when it's home.

title: The Right Person
script_text:
The right person makes you fall in love three times.
Once with them, once with yourself, and once with life.
They see the person hidden beneath you.
They notice even the smallest fracture in your soul.
They love your very soul, and they heal your very soul.

title: I Wish You The Absolute Best
script_text:
I wish you happiness always, wherever you may be.
Even if life takes you far away from me, your presence will remain in my heart forever, unchanged.
You are no longer with me, but I still wish nothing but the very best for you.
The time we spent together has become only a memory,
but I'm so grateful someone like you was part of my life, even if only for a season.

title: Undress My Soul
script_text:
Undress my soul.
Open every folded petal.
Dig into the bark of my strength.
Search the artifacts of my heart.
Before soaking my body in your eyes, and your touch.

title: The Heart Mourns, The Life It Was Meant To Live
script_text:
If you want to know where your heart is, look to where your mind goes when it wanders.
It returns to the people you miss, the dreams you buried,
and the life you secretly ache for.
Because deep down, the heart mourns the life it was meant to live.

title: Not Limited To This Lifetime
script_text:
Maybe it's okay that I lost you in this life.
But I still keep hoping that somewhere in another lifetime, I'll find you again.
And in that lifetime, I'll never let you go.
We'll hold hands and walk together in peace,
never to be parted again.

title: Walls Have Ears. Doors Have Eyes
script_text:
Walls have ears, doors have eyes.
Trees have voices, beasts tell lies.
They wear the rain, they wear the snow.
They wear the man you think you know.

title: Enough Playing
script_text:
Half of life is lost charming others.
The other half is lost in the anxieties they cause.
Leave this play.
You've played enough.

title: We Don't Experience The Same Rain
script_text:
We don't experience the same rain.
Some have umbrellas, some have roofs, and some only have themselves.
That's why we should be kinder, slower to judge, and quicker to understand.
You'll never know how heavy someone's rain is, until you've stood where they are.

title: I Like You vs I Love You
script_text:
What's the difference between I like you and I love you?
If you like a flower, you pick it.
If you love a flower, you care for it, water it daily, and protect it.
That's the difference between liking and loving.
And when you truly understand that difference, you understand life.

title: Every Day, You Have Two Choices
script_text:
Every day you have two choices to focus on what's wrong, or embrace what is right,
choose gratitude, choose joy, choose to see the beauty and the little things,
and life will become even more incredible than you imagined.

title: Next Life
script_text:
I'm lucky because I found you, because I got to know the real you.
I can't imagine a world where you belong to someone else.
Please, let's never become strangers.
May the hands we're holding today never let go throughout this journey.
